title: API keys
description: Keys let other systems use the FieldOps API and MCP server for this organization. A key acts as the member who created it, limited to its scopes.
demoNote: In the public demo, keys are deleted with the nightly reset.
emptyHint: Create a key to connect an integration, a script or an MCP client.

create.title: New API key
create.description: The key acts as you, within your role, and only with the scope you choose.
create.name: Name
create.nameHint: So you can tell keys apart later.
create.scopeReadHint: GET requests and the MCP server.
create.scopeWriteHint: Also creates, changes and deletes records.

created.title: Copy your new key
created.description: This is the only time the key is shown. Store it somewhere safe, such as a password manager or your integration's secrets.
created.copyFailed: Couldn't copy. Select the key and copy it by hand.

revoke.label: Revoke {name}
revoke.title: Revoke “{name}”?
revoke.description: Requests with this key stop working at once. This can't be undone; create a new key if you need one again.

rest.title: REST API
rest.description: Send the key as a bearer token. Every endpoint is described in the API reference.
rest.limits: Each key can make {perKey} requests a minute. Every response carries RateLimit-Limit, RateLimit-Remaining and RateLimit-Reset headers; past the limit the API answers 429 with Retry-After.
rest.limitsOff: Requests with a key aren't rate-limited on this server.

mcp.title: Connect an MCP client
mcp.description: Ask Claude or another MCP client about your jobs, SLA risks, technicians' workload and customers. The tools are read-only and use a key with the Read scope.
mcp.tools: Tools: search jobs, get a job, SLA risks, technician workload, customer history, pending approvals and, for owners and admins, revenue.
